subject.title: fix(agents): bound IDENTITY.md reads to prevent OOM

question: Should parsed workspace identity metadata support only regular IDENTITY.md files up to 1 MiB, with oversized, symlinked, and non-regular inputs silently treated as absent?
rationale: The implementation safely fixes the unbounded allocation, but it also intentionally changes accepted workspace inputs and gives affected users no explanation when file-derived identity disappears.

options.title: Accept bounded regular files
options.body: Make regular IDENTITY.md files up to 1 MiB the supported parsed metadata contract and retain the existing silent null fallback.

options.title: Preserve symlink compatibility
options.body: Use a different bounded-read path that continues to accept previously readable symlink targets.

options.title: Require discoverable rejection
options.body: Keep the strict reader but add a warning or doctor diagnostic explaining why identity metadata was ignored.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded regular files
recommendation.body: Make regular IDENTITY.md files up to 1 MiB the supported parsed metadata contract and retain the existing silent null fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available history owner for the current identity metadata loader, its consumers, and the regular-file boundary.
